request.post_data:
{"query":"
    query nextUpMarkets($sportId: ID, $baseCompetitionId: ID, $competitionId: ID, $eventIds: [ID!], $eventLimit: Int, $isMainMarketTypeGroup: Boolean, $fsgmEnabled: Boolean, $sgmEnabled: Boolean, $marketLimit: Int, $featuredFlag: Boolean) {
  nextUpMarkets(
    sport_id: $sportId
    base_competition_id: $baseCompetitionId
    competition_id: $competitionId
    event_ids: $eventIds
    fsgm_enabled: $fsgmEnabled
    sgm_enabled: $sgmEnabled
    featured_flag: $featuredFlag
    limit: $eventLimit
  ) {
    ...NextUpMarket
  }
}
    
    fragment NextUpMarket on Next {
  sport_id
  sport_name
  base_competition_id
  base_competition_name
  competition_id
  competition_name
  event_id
  event_name
  event_start_date
  event_status
  event_sgm_enabled
  event_fsgm_enabled
  teams {
    ...Team
  }
  markets(
    is_main_market_type_group: $isMainMarketTypeGroup
    limit: $marketLimit
    is_fsgm_market: $fsgmEnabled
  ) {
    ...Market
  }
}
    
    fragment Team on Team {
  id
  name
  color
  team_position
  players {
    id
    name
    first_name
    last_name
  }
}
    

    fragment Market on MarketView {
  id
  name
  status
  market_type_id
  market_type_name
  event_id
  market_score_home
  market_score_away
  market_score_total
  display_flag
  refund_flag
  allow_multiple_selection
  selections {
    ...Selection
  }
  sort_order
}
    
    fragment Selection on SelectionView {
  id
  market_id
  event_id
  name
  status
  odds
  sort_order
  external_id
  is_home_team
  is_away_team
}
    ","variables":{"marketLimit":1,"isMainMarketTypeGroup":true,"eventLimit":15,"featuredFlag":true},"operationName":"nextUpMarkets"}
